اصطفين (form VIII)
# اِصْطَفَيْنَ (iṣṭafayna) /isˤ.tˤa.faj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# اُصْطُفِينَ (uṣṭufīna) /usˤ.tˤu.fiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# اِصْطَفِينَ (iṣṭafīna) /isˤ.tˤa.fiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
